name: Chembond Chemicals Limited
summary: Chembond Chemicals Limited manufactures, trades, and provides services for specialty chemicals products in India. It offers a range of chemicals, equipment systems, and technical services for total water management and water re-use across the industrial, and C and I sectors. The company also provides admixtures, sealants, various cement-based ready-to-use products, waterproofing solutions, and curing compounds for the construction industry. Chembond Chemicals Limited was incorporated in 2023 and is based in Navi Mumbai, India.
